    args: path (str, path relative to repo root), start (int, first line (default 1)), end (int, last line (optional))

    State the exact method name you believe contains the bug. Checked against the codebase; required to leave COLLECT.

- finish
    Declare the bug fixed. Only call after run_tests reports all tests passing.
    args: none
- escalate
    Stop and ask a human one specific, answerable question. Use when repeated attempts fail for the same reason.
    args: reason (str, what you tried and why it failed), question (str, one specific question)
